=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven and burning village images
as visual guidance for this scene.

Maintain the established cinematic appearance of Riven
and the burning village environment.

The final moment of this scene must naturally lead into
the established image of Riven lying on the ground
with her sword lying intact in front of her.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Late sunset moving into a darker smoky atmosphere.

Grounded realistic movement.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Dense smoke, firelight, drifting ash and embers.

Mysterious and restrained.

No clear monster reveal.

No combat sequence.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== SCENE ===

Continue with Riven moving deeper into the burning village.

She is searching for her father.

The streets become quieter and more empty.

Burning buildings remain around her,
but the chaos feels increasingly distant.

Riven walks carefully through thick smoke and debris.

She looks between the ruined houses.

She calls:

"Father!"


No answer.


Riven continues forward.

She notices strange dark marks
across damaged wood and parts of the ground.

They do not look like ordinary fire damage.

Riven briefly examines them,
but she does not understand what caused them.


Then she hears a faint sound somewhere ahead.

Riven immediately looks toward it.

She thinks it may be her father.


Riven calls more quietly:

"Father?"


She follows the sound deeper into the smoke.


Through the smoke ahead,
something dark briefly moves between the ruined buildings.

Riven stops.

She tries to see through the smoke.


For only a brief moment,
a vague dark silhouette can be seen far ahead.

Its identity and shape are impossible to understand.

Do not clearly reveal a creature.

Do not show a readable face.

Do not explain what it is.


Riven takes a cautious step forward.


The silhouette disappears into the smoke.


Riven looks around.

Nothing.


A short silence.


Then Riven suddenly senses movement from another direction.

She turns—

A powerful unseen impact strikes her before she can react.


Do not clearly show what attacks her.


Riven is violently knocked off balance
and thrown onto the ground.


Her intact sword slips from her hand
and slides across the dirt away from her.


Riven hits the ground hard.

She is stunned but still conscious.


End with the sword lying intact on the ground
several feet in front of Riven.

Riven lies behind it,
trying to recover from the impact.


The attacker remains completely unseen.


CUT.
